This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal sentient species was distinguished by their [[Color|white]] skin, four black [[eye]]s, and lobes that dangled down from the sides of both lips.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="TLJ Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> a member of this species was present in [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]] when the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] arrived searching for the [[Master Codebreaker]].<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Casino-Alien-49.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Casino Alien 49 by Jake Lunt Davies]]
This species first appeared in the [[2017]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi]]'', directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> This species was designed by creature concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]], with their concept art being titled "Casino Alien 49."<ref name="Davies">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref>
